exposure: Study group: STSH level between 3.1 to 6.2 mIU/L
Control group: STSH levels between 0.4 to 3 mIU/L
cohort: Pregnant women with ≤ 20 weeks gestation attending antenatal OPD
finding: The study found no significant difference in maternal and fetal outcomes between pregnant Indian women with STSH levels between 3.1-6.2 mIU/L and those with STSH levels between 0.4-3 mIU/L, suggesting that the lower STSH cut-off recommended for diagnosing hypothyroidism in pregnancy may not be universally applicable.
